% A \par in memoir's \title, with its \pretitle and \posttitle, and an
% \endgraf. The document builds, and the page's title holds the text.
\documentclass{memoir}
\pretitle{\begin{center}\LARGE}
\posttitle{\par\end{center}}
\title{First\par Second\endgraf Third}
\author{Someone}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
Some text.
\end{document}
